Act.description: A labelled action: a screen's button, a swipe, a menu item.

Action.description: What a client sends when a control is used: the screen, the block, the action and its values (a composer send's `nonce`: random per send, repeated on its retry).

Answer.description: A server's answer to an action: ops on the screen, a toast, close the sheet or open a screen.

AppBlock.description: A block of a `type` that is no core kind: an app's own, kept whole.

Attachment.description: A message's attachment: its name and what opens it; with `src` it is an image, drawn small.

Band.description: A band of a scene's repo: a header over its rows, or over blocks.

Bar.description: One progress bar: its value from 0 to 100 and its tone.

Block.description: A block: an object whose `type` names its kind; any other `type` is an app's own.

Bound.description: A value bound to local state: it shows the text of state key `get`.

BulkAction.description: An action on the ticked rows: it sends `{rows: [ids]}`.

Bye.description: The stream's last event, and why it ends.

Card.description: A card: an ask, a run, a config or a proposal.

Cell.description: A table cell: text (an ISO date's too), a number, or a toned label; a missing cell is blank.

Chart.description: A chart of named series over x values: bar, stacked, line, combo or donut.

Check.description: A field's test: while `ok` does not hold, the field shows `say` and its form's submit is off.

Child.description: What an `insert` adds: a block, a scene's lane, a row's round or a table's row.

Chips.description: A row of chips, one or many selected.

Choice.description: A question with options, a free answer and a default.

ChoiceDefault.description: The answer a choice takes by itself at `until`.

Column.description: A table's column: its id, header, kind, and how it aligns, formats, totals, sizes and shows on a phone.

Composer.description: A message box: its send action, its chips and the messages queued; each send, queue or steer carries `values.nonce`, a fresh random id a retry repeats.

ComposerChip.description: A composer's picker: its name, current value and choices.

Confirm.description: The question asked before an action runs.

DaySpan.description: What a move, a stretch or a draw gives: the bar's `id` for the first two, the `row` for a draw.

Diagram.description: A diagram from its source, with counts and its nodes.

Editor.description: A text editor and its errors.

Expr.description: The behaviour language: a tree sent like any field, `{"get":"email"}` or a bare value.

Fallback.description: What a client with no view for a block's `type` draws: a plain row.

Field.description: A form's field: an object whose `type` names its type; any other `type` is kept whole and drawn as text.

FieldDrawn.description: How a renderer drew a field: its type's own view, a plain text input, or not at all.

FieldNode.description: One field of a form in the drawn tree.

FieldValue.description: A field's value: text, a number or a switch.

Figure.description: A row's figure: its state, tool, icon or avatar.

FileLink.description: A file the app sends: its name and where to fetch it.

FileRef.description: A file the app holds, as its file handler answered it; `src` is a picture of it the app serves.

Finding.description: A rule's verdict on one block of one file, carrying the rule's fix.

Fold.description: What a folded card shows: one line and its main action.

Form.description: A form of fields; also the `config` kind.

Frame.description: One key's change: ops that apply only on rev `from`, or with no `from` the whole screen.

Gesture.description: A gesture a block allows: the action its result is sent as, under `name` in the action's values.

Handler.description: What the harness's file handler does with a picked file: answers with an id, rejects it, or never answers.

Have.description: A key a client opens, with the rev of its copy when that copy came from the same epoch.

Hello.description: The stream's first event: the version it runs at, the stream's id, the server's epoch and its key limit.

Hero.description: A page's opening: a title, a line, a picture and its actions.

Import.description: A spreadsheet import the app's server reads: upload a file, check the column match and the row errors, confirm one action.

ImportColumn.description: A column the screen takes: its key in the match, its header, type, whether it is required and its allowed values.

ImportDone.description: What the app took at import: how many rows, how many were left out, and a file of those.

ImportFile.description: The picked file as the app's server read it: its file handler id, name, size in bytes, row count and sheets.

ImportRow.description: A row of the file: its spreadsheet row number, its cells and the server's reasons, both by column key.

ImportSheet.description: The server's answer to `read`: the file, its headers, the match (column key to header), the first rows and every bad row.

Island.description: A client component the app hosts: its props in, its named events out.

IslandSize.description: The box an island holds before it loads: a width and height, or an aspect.

KeyState.description: A key as the server holds it: current (rev only), the ops since the rev sent, the whole screen, or gone.

Label.description: A short text and its tone: a badge, or a toned subtitle.

LineError.description: An editor's error on a line.

LineItem.description: One row of a `lines` block: its id and its values by column name.

Lines.description: Repeating rows of fields with add and remove, running totals and a balance check.

Lit.description: A plain value, written bare: null, a switch, a number or a string.

Locale.description: A screen's language, era and today: the words a field draws, the years it shows, the day it marks.

Mark.description: A mark the app keeps on a picture: places are `[x, y]` from 0 to 1 of it, `to` a two-ended mark's other end.

Match.description: A value and the pattern it is tested against.

Media.description: A picture or a video of a known size.

Message.description: One message of a conversation: who said it, what was said as blocks, and its attachments.

More.description: A list's next page: a link to it, or an action that loads it in place.

NavLink.description: A link of a site's bar.

Nodes.description: A diagram's nodes: a list of nodes by `id`, or a map of nodes by name.

OldFrame.description: A frame of the old per-screen stream, `{"seq", "ops"}`, as cooee reads it today.

Op.description: One edit to a screen; a block is named by its id.

OtherField.description: A field of a type this version does not know: kept whole, drawn as a one-line text input.

Page.description: A table's or list's next page: the action to send and the app's opaque cursor.

PageImage.description: One page of a `pages` block: its picture, what it shows, and its size in pixels.

Pages.description: A document as the app's server drew it, one picture a page: paged and zoomed in the view, with its PDF.

Part.description: One part of a prose tree.

Pattern.description: A named test of a value; never a regex.

Pending.description: A screen's bar of unsaved changes.

PickerField.description: One of a list of options.

Plan.description: What a harness draws: each run in one process, its shots under `<out>/<run>/` and every `Seen` in `<out>/seen.json`.

PlanRun.description: One screen drawn at one size with the app's CSS, scripts and kinds; the probes run when `probes` is set.

Prose.description: Text as a tree of headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes and code.

Queued.description: A message queued for the turn's end.

Round.description: One round of a row's work: its state, lane, blocks and links.

RoundLane.description: The lane that ran a round.

RowError.description: An app's check on a `lines` block: on a row and a column, or on the whole block.

Run.description: A command the owner approves to run.

ScanField.description: Paper pages from the camera or picked photos: each is cornered, corrected to A4 and reviewed, then sent as one PDF's id.

SceneRepo.description: A scene's repo: its colour, its summary line and its bands of lanes.

SceneRow.description: One row of a scene's band: an issue or a lane, with its host, the issue it needs you on and its blocker.

Secret.description: A secret's input: its value is never sent back.

SecretField.description: A password input: its value is never drawn back, and an empty one is not sent.

Seen.description: What a rule or a probe measured, with no severity and no fix: only `guard::finding` makes a `Finding`.

Series.description: One named series of a chart: a value per x, its tone, a combo's mark and a dashed line.

SetState.description: A tap's change of local state: `key` becomes the value of `to`; nothing is sent.

Severity.description: How a finding counts: an error fails when it is new, a warning is printed and never fails.

Shown.description: A shown value (a row's or tile's value, a card's meta, a label's text): a string, a number, a state key's value, or a time.

Span.description: A run of text and how it is set.

Stage.description: One step of a stepper: a done one with a tap can be pressed.

Stat.description: Figures: a list of tiles, or one tile inline.

Step.description: One scripted input: by block id, a stream frame arriving, an action answered, or a shot.

StepFile.description: A file picked in an upload field: its name, its size in bytes, its media type and what the handler does.

StepGesture.description: A gesture on one item of a block: pointer offsets `[dx, dy]` in px, key nudges, or named actions, in turn.

StepOn.description: The block a tap or a scroll goes to.

StepRefuse.description: The action out fails, with its toast as the reason.

StepShot.description: A PNG and a tree taken under this name.

StepType.description: Text typed into a block's field.

Steps.description: A stepper of named steps with its current one, or progress bars.

Submit.description: A form's or a sheet's submit button.

Sync.description: A client's request: the keys to open, each with the rev it holds, and the keys to close.

Synced.description: The server's answer to a `Sync`: one state per key opened.

Table.description: A data table: typed columns, rows by id, sort, filter, totals, row select and export.

TableRow.description: One row of a table: its id, its cells by column id, what a tap on it does, whether it stays put, or heads a group.

TableSelect.description: A table's row select: a tick box per row and its bulk actions.

TableSort.description: A table's starting order: one column, up or down.

Tap.description: What a tap does: open a screen or sheet, send an action, open a thread or a URL, focus, copy.

Text.description: Text: markdown, or a plain styled line.

Time.description: A moment a value counts from or to; `label` shows it, `{}` the age since `since`, `{rel}` what is left until `until`.

TimeBar.description: A bar from `start` to `end`, both ISO days and both drawn; `fixed` takes no gesture.

TimeRow.description: One row of a timeline: its title and the bars on it.

Timeline.description: Rows of bars on a day axis from `from` to `to` (ISO days); `move`, `stretch` and `draw` each send a `DaySpan`.

Timings.description: How long the first paint and each step took; the frame fields only where a harness draws real frames.

Toast.description: A short line after an action, in a tone, with an optional undo: an answer's toast, or drawn where it sits.

Toned.description: A subtitle: plain text, or text with a tone.

Tool.description: One tool call: its name, a one-line summary, its state, and a body shown when it is opened.

TreeDrawn.description: How a renderer drew a block: its own view, its fallback, or not at all.

TreeNode.description: One block of the drawn tree; `rect` and `text` come from a harness, never from `expect`.

Undo.description: A toast's undo: its label (default "undo") and the action it sends, with any confirm.

UploadField.description: Files or photos: each picked file goes to the app's file handler, and the field sends their ids.

Via.description: How a scripted gesture comes in: a pointer, the keys, or a named accessibility action.

Weather.description: A scene's sky: its kind, wind from 0 to 1, fog from 0 to 2, a storm, and its line.

Web.description: A web view of a fixed height.

Why.description: Why a stream was ended by the server.

Working.description: A composer's turn in progress: when it started.

description: One key's change: ops that apply only on rev `from`, or with no `from` the whole screen.
